gloss: air conditioning and heating; climate control

definitions.gloss: air conditioning and heating; climate control
definitions.explanation: Equipment or systems that both cool and heat indoor spaces; collectively, indoor climate control. Compound of {冷房|れいぼう} (cooling) and {暖房|だんぼう} (heating).

examples.japanese: {冷暖房|れいだんぼう}⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}いている→効く：01932_kiku⟧。
examples.english: This room has the AC and heating working.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設定温度|せっていおんど}→設定温度：23470_setteiondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}した→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: To cut electricity costs, I reviewed the climate-control temperature settings.

notes:
Refers jointly to cooling and heating equipment. Frequently seen in rental and facility listings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷暖房|れいだんぼう}⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧: fully equipped with AC and heating
- {冷暖房|れいだんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the climate control is effective
- {冷暖房|れいだんぼう}⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧: climate-control facilities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧: air conditioner — the appliance itself, which today usually does both cooling and heating
- ⟦{空調|くうちょう}→空調：27362_kuuchou⟧: air conditioning (system) — more technical, includes ventilation
